title: 5 biggest mistakes beginners make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 78% of AI tool users fail within their first month?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing faster than most people realize.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest mistake? Using tools without understanding the basics.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Most beginners rely on default settings instead of customizing prompts.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone from marketers to students — wasting time and money.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Always start by defining your goal before using any AI tool.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one AI feature you’re using wrong right now?
